messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I have a couple of questions and I’m hoping you can help me out quickly. First, I need to check how much is left on my gift card. Also, for my most recent order, I can’t remember if I used my Visa, Mastercard, or Amex—can you tell me which one I used? And if possible, I’d like to use my gift card for that order instead. If that’s not allowed, I’d like to switch the payment to my Visa. Can you help me with all this?

Yes—I can help, but I first need to authenticate your account.

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **Your first name + last name + ZIP code**

Once I have that, I’ll:
- check **how much is left on your gift card**, and
- look up your **most recent order** to tell you whether it was paid with **Visa / Mastercard / Amex**, and
- if the order is still **pending**, switch the payment to your **gift card** (or to **Visa** if gift card isn’t allowed/doesn’t cover it).

If you know the **order ID** already, you can include it too (optional).
Sure, my email is isabella.lopez3271@example.com. I don’t have the order ID handy right now, but hopefully my email is enough!
